channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Journalism & Writers, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Journalism & Writers, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Harry Ransom Center Research Fellowships 2027-2028 (Austin, Texas)
item.description: Harry Ransom Center, The University of Texas at Austin · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · Postdoctoral Fellowships: USD 3,500 per month for one or two months. Dissertation Fellowships: USD 2,500. Travel Stipends: USD 2,000 (open to graduate students, faculty and independent researchers including artists and journalists). International recipients get an extra USD 500. No application fee.

item.title: Nieman Fellowships at Harvard, Class of 2028
item.description: Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · USD 87,500 stipend paid over the nine-month academic year (2026-27 figure), plus additional allowances for housing, childcare and health insurance. Fellows audit courses across Harvard and participate in Nieman seminars, master classes and workshops. No application fee.

item.title: Stigler Center: Journalists in Residence Program Spring 2027 (Chicago Booth)
item.description: Stigler Center, University of Chicago Booth School of Business · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · USD 14,000 stipend to cover living expenses over the 12-week program, plus reimbursement of economy-class airfare to and from Chicago, SEVIS and visa application fees, health insurance through UChicago, and housing guidance. The stipend is subject to up to 14 percent tax withholding for international participants, and you need sufficient funds for roughly the first month before the stipend arrives. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Journalism & Writers fellowships - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Princeton Arts Fellowship 2027-2029 (Lewis Center for the Arts)
    https://apply.interfolio.com/187043
    Princeton University, Lewis Center for the Arts · deadline 08 Sep 2026 · USD 93,000 salary per year for each of two academic years, as a full-time 24-month appointment at the rank of Associate Professional Specialist. No application fee.
  • American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Journalism & Writers fellowships - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:

    https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/propublica/jobs/4577283006
    ProPublica · deadline 17 Aug 2026 · $9,000 stipend, paid as two instalments of $4,500 (one at the start of the programme, one at the midpoint), plus a fully funded journalism conference trip with accommodation and expenses covered. No application fee.
  • Trusted Creator Fellowship 2026 (News Creator Corps)
    https://newscreatorcorps.org/programs/trusted-creator/apply/

item.title: 2 new Journalism & Writers fellowships - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Cullman Center Fellowships 2027-28 (New York Public Library)
